_comment: QA fixture: label derivation, uniqueness and typed-label validation vectors (UX-SOURCES.md 5.4, 5.6; ARCHITECTURE-SOURCES.md 3.2 defaultSourceLabel; SR5 cap 64).
derive: Model.deriveLabel(url, kind) / defaultSourceLabel. unique: Model.uniqueLabel(label, existing). validate: Model.validateLabel(label, existingLabels, selfId).

expect.code uses the UX 5.4 codes (label_too_long, label_taken); decision names an open lead ruling (docs/QA-SOURCES.md section 10). Unknown keys must be ignored by a loader; padTo means pad with 'a' to that many characters.

derive.note: UX 5.6 appends :port; ARCH 3.2 uses the host as validateSourceUrl computes it (no port)
never the userinfo, path or query
UX 5.6 strips a leading www.; ARCH 3.2 says no www. stripping
lowercased host of the normalized URL
file:///srv/tv/a%20b.m3u normalizes to this path first
empty last segment -> the ARCH fallback string
Xtream: the server host, never username or password
IDN host kept as typed (lowercase), no punycode; renders as PlainText
case-insensitive comparison (UX 5.6); ARCH compares taken labels as typed
loader: replace LONGHOST with 70 x 'a'; the derived label is capped at 64 (SR5)

validate.label: provider
validate.note: case-insensitive; the message quotes the existing label with U+201C/U+201D

validate.label: Provider
validate.note: editing a source and keeping its own label is not a collision
empty means derive (UX 5.6: renaming to the derived default is allowed)

validate.label: -u critical
validate.note: SEC: rendered literally as PlainText; no notification carries a label (UX 8 item 23), so omarchy-notification-send never sees it

validate.label: --urgency=critical ${path}
validate.note: SEC: never reaches mpv (--title is a channel name, not a source label); literal on screen

validate.label: `id`; $(id) | rm -rf ~ > x
validate.note: SEC: shell metacharacters are data; the label only ever travels inside JSON (state.json) and QML properties

validate.label:
line1
line2
validate.note: a multi-line paste collapses to one line

validate.label: ‮RTL label‬
validate.note: bidi controls are not C0/C1: kept; SRC-SEC checks the row renders without reordering the host segment

validate.label: LABEL-64
validate.note: loader: pad with 'a' to 64 characters; exactly the cap is accepted

validate.label: LABEL-65
validate.note: UX 5.4 quotes 40; SR5 makes 64 canonical and the copy must say 64

validate.label: bold & x
validate.note: SEC: Text.PlainText everywhere the label is rendered; StyledText would render the markup

validate.label: üüüüüüüü
validate.note: 8 non-ASCII characters, 8 UTF-16 units: fine in both engines

validate.label: EMOJI-33
validate.note: 33 emoji = 66 UTF-16 units: ARCH caps in UTF-16 units (too long); Python len() counts 33 code points (fine). Parity note for the helper's normalize_state, which must not drop a record the guide accepted
